products.name: Android Dedicated (COSU) / Kiosk Device Enrollment & Management in Intune — Commercial
products.short_description: Stand up Android dedicated (COSU) / kiosk devices in Intune — token/QR/NFC/zero-touch enrollment, single/multi-app kiosk, restrictions, managed Google Play apps, and remote management — so purpose-built devices deploy consistently and stay locked down. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Deploy locked-down Android dedicated/kiosk devices at scale

Frontline, warehouse, retail, and clinical dedicated Android devices need to boot straight into one app or a curated set — no personal use, no wandering. This solution stands up Android dedicated (COSU) devices in Intune: enrollment via token / QR / NFC / zero-touch, the kiosk profile (single-app or multi-app), device restrictions, managed Google Play app delivery, and remote management — so a fleet of purpose-built devices deploys consistently and stays locked down.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the dedicated/COSU model, enrollment methods (token/QR/NFC/zero-touch), single- vs multi-app kiosk, and the OEM/rugged considerations at pattern level.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (Intune + Android Enterprise + managed Google Play, admin roles, device hardware, network).
  • Implementation Guide — create the dedicated enrollment profile, build the kiosk (single/multi-app) + restrictions, assign managed Google Play apps, enroll via the chosen method, and validate the locked-down experience — pilot-first, each profile named.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic Microsoft Graph / Intune automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
  • Validation gates (devices boot to kiosk, only allowed apps, remote-manageable) plus Best Practices for a scalable dedicated-device fleet.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A fleet of purpose-built Android devices that boot straight to the job — enrolled at scale, locked to their apps, remotely managed — consistent and tamper-resistant.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • COSU-Discovery.ps1 — Android dedicated (COSU) readiness assessment: binding, profiles, apps, restrictions (read-only)
    • COSU-Report.ps1 — enrolled dedicated-fleet health / inventory report (read-only)
    • COSU-Set-Configuration.ps1 — create the dedicated enrollment profile + kiosk device-restrictions profile (default -WhatIf)
    • COSU-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — build the dynamic dedicated-device group keyed on the enrollment profile (default -WhatIf)
    • COSU-Validation.ps1 — kiosk allow-list vs assigned apps ("only allowed apps") validation report (read-only)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
